notes: Qty 57 as published. The description says the deck uses the Set Your Course For Alderaan objective, but the list does not include it, so it is not added.

The interrupt line '(starting interupt that gives you 3 effects)' names no card; it dested Prepared Defenses, the only Dark starting Interrupt that deploys up to three Effects. The strategy says the starting Effects are up to the player (usually Imperial Arrest Order, Come Here You Big Coward and Mobilization Points).
Posted 'CS Docking Bay' names no clear site (Cloud City and Coruscant docking bays are listed separately); kept as posted and marked UNKNOWN.
